verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say it automatically generates a meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting. These are AI-generated insights and suggestions delivered inside the product, backed by AI summary, AI action items and an in-product 'Ask Fellow' feature listed on the pricing page. missing for 10: documentation of what Ask Fellow does in-app, evidence of insights that span multiple meetings inside the product (the cross-meeting Q&A evidence is via the external MCP connector), independent or hands-on corroboration.
